am writing to raise a concern about the behaviour and communication of a GP I saw today, Dr Ahmed/Ahmad, during my son appointment at 13:00 on 25th February 2026.

Over a month ago, I attended the surgery regarding concerns about my 4-year-old son’s behaviour and possible ADHD. At that time, I saw a different doctor (unfortunately I do not remember his name). He listened very carefully, understood our worries, and supported us. He referred my son to Havering CAMHS for assessment.

Around three weeks ago, we received a letter from Havering CAMHS stating they could not accept the referral as they are dealing with more urgent cases. Because of this, I booked today’s appointment to discuss the next steps.

However, when I attended the appointment with Dr Ahmed/Ahmad, I felt completely dismissed. As soon as I began explaining the situation, he interrupted me and told me that I “should have gone online and used Right to Choose for ADHD.” He did not allow me to explain the full context, and his tone felt rude and uncaring. I became upset and even cried during the consultation, but I felt ignored. He repeated that there was nothing more he could do and that I should go online and complete the referral myself.

This was extremely distressing, especially as I had an endoscopy scheduled shortly after the appointment, and the interaction caused me significant stress.

A few hours later, Dr Ahmed/Ahmad phoned me to say he had spoken with the doctor who originally saw my son and that my son should be referred to a psychiatrist instead. He confirmed he had now made that referral. When I tried to ask questions, he said he could not continue the conversation because he needed to go. I asked if he could speak to my son’s father, but he refused twice. Again, I felt my concerns were not listened to or respected.

I have three children and have attended doctors and hospitals many times over the years, but I have never experienced such behaviour from a GP. I did not feel supported, heard, or treated with respect, and the interaction left me extremely upset.

I am requesting that the practice review this incident and speak to the doctor involved. I also request that the phone call be reviewed, as I believe no patient or parent should be spoken to in this manner. I will also be submitting a formal complaint for further investigation.

Thank you for taking the time to read this and for looking into the concerns I have
